dashboard_recap.headline: MLB Daily Recap - August 15, 2026
dashboard_recap.article:
**MLB Recap: Thursday's Action Packs Power**

The MLB saw a flurry of high-scoring games on Thursday, with several players delivering impressive performances. Eduardo Valencia led the charge with a two-home run game for the Chicago White Sox, driving in two runs against the Detroit Tigers. Valencia's 2-for-4 effort helped the White Sox secure a 4-3 win, with Jordan Hicks earning the save.

Meanwhile, Joshua Báez continued his hot streak with three home runs and five RBIs for the St. Louis Cardinals, who routed the Chicago Cubs 8-4. Michael McGreevy picked up the win with six strong innings, striking out six and allowing no earned runs.

In another high-scoring affair, Cole Young homered and drove in four runs for the Seattle Mariners, who topped the Houston Astros 10-5. Emerson Hancock earned the win with seven solid innings, striking out eight and surrendering two earned runs.

In the American League East, Wilyer Abreu homered and drove in one run for the Boston Red Sox, who blanked the Pittsburgh Pirates 4-0. Sonny Gray earned the win with seven scoreless innings, striking out seven and allowing just six hits.

In the National League West, Nolan Arenado homered twice and drove in four runs for the Arizona Diamondbacks, who routed the Atlanta Braves 10-3. Eduardo Rodriguez earned the win with six solid innings, striking out five and allowing two earned runs.

Finally, Reid Detmers threw a complete-game shutout for the Los Angeles Angels, striking out 11 and allowing just two hits in a 1-0 win over the Kansas City Royals.
